document_title: FOUNDATIONS of the Russian Federation State Policy in the Arctic for the Period up to 2035 (Revised)
source_file: RUSSIA MARITIME STUDIES INSTITUTE | UNITED STATES NAVAL WAR COLLEGE
key_objectives: improve quality of life for population including indigenous minorities
accelerate economic development and increase contribution to national growth
protect environment, preserve native lands and traditional way of life
conduct mutually beneficial cooperation based on international law
safeguard national interests in the Arctic
red_lines: attempts by foreign states to revise basic provisions of international treaties governing economic activities in the Arctic
unsettled international legal delimitation of maritime areas in the Arctic
actions obstructing legitimate economic or other activities in the Arctic
military buildup and increase of potential for conflict in the region
decision_heuristics: if population decline occurs, then implement measures to improve living conditions and attract residents
if infrastructure development lags, then prioritize state support for businesses and investment projects
escalation_ladder: establish regulatory framework and organizational environment
create conditions for major economic projects in the Arctic zone
implement integrated infrastructure along the Northern Sea Route
promote mutually beneficial cooperation with other Arctic states
key_quotes: "The primary national interests of the Russian Federation in the Arctic are: ensuring sovereignty and territorial integrity, preserving the Arctic as a territory of peace, stability, and mutually beneficial partnership, increasing quality of life for population, developing the Arctic zone as a strategic resource base, developing the Northern Sea Route, protecting environment"

“The goals of the State Policy of the Russian Federation in the Arctic are: to improve the quality of life for the population in the Arctic zone, accelerate economic development, protect the environment and traditional way of life, conduct mutually beneficial cooperation based on international law, safeguard national interests”
validation_note: Parameters flagged as inferred (acceptable with confidence discount)

document_title: RUSSIAN PRESIDENT'S DECREE About National Security Strategies
source_file: Russian Federation Decree No. 400 signed on July 2, 2021 by Vladimir Putin
key_objectives: Strengthening defense capability and internal unity
Modernizing the economy and developing industrial capacity
Ensuring sovereignty and independent foreign policy
Improving welfare and protecting dignity of Russian citizens
red_lines: Attempts to interfere in Russia's internal affairs
Use of military force against the territorial integrity of Russia
Deployment of U.S. medium- and short-range missiles in Europe and Asia-Pacific region
decision_heuristics: If external pressure increases, then strengthen defense capabilities and sovereignty
If socio-economic problems arise, then improve public administration efficiency and fight corruption
escalation_ladder: Monitoring of external threats and intelligence activities
Deployment of defensive measures against potential conflicts
key_quotes: The Russian Federation's consistent policy of strengthening defence capability, internal unity and political stability, modernizing the economy and developing industrial capacity has strengthened Russia's sovereign statehood as a country capable of pursuing an independent foreign and domestic policy.
Only a harmonious combination of a strong power and human well-being will ensure the formation of a just society and prosperity of Russia.
